sources.name: Advocato
sources.observedStrength: fast search by legal problem and location, clear category chips, simple three-step explanation, and separate lawyer joining path
sources.safeTransfer: make the first action feel fast and understandable, while keeping unverifiable ratings or market-leader claims out of Jus-Tice copy
sources.avoidCopying: do not copy testimonials, ratings, exact category wording, or claims about thousands of lawyers

sources.name: LawZone
sources.observedStrength: direct route from a legal issue to a conversation with a lawyer, broad legal-area taxonomy, and urgency language around personal follow-up
sources.safeTransfer: add clearer routes for urgent situations and explain what the visitor should prepare before a lawyer call
sources.avoidCopying: do not copy aggressive matching promises, sales language, or any direct-call promise without operational proof

sources.name: iLaw
sources.observedStrength: large legal-topic map, forums, articles, case-law/news navigation and many subtopics under each practice area
sources.safeTransfer: expand practice cards with more human explanation and subtopic context instead of making the page thinner
sources.avoidCopying: do not turn Jus-Tice into a dense old-style directory or duplicate their topic lists

sources.name: MyAttorney
sources.observedStrength: area-based lawyer search, recommended-lawyer cards and simple public-facing legal categories
sources.safeTransfer: show local confidence and nearby-help language without implying rankings or recommendations that are not verified
sources.avoidCopying: do not create fake recommendation labels, fake review hierarchy, or unsupported local availability claims

sources.name: Vaquill AI awesome legaltech
sources.observedStrength: curated legaltech map with open-source platforms, AI tools, datasets, MCP servers and verification warnings
sources.safeTransfer: translate the idea into Jus-Tice as evidence-based intake, source grounding and human review gates rather than importing foreign-law code directly
sources.avoidCopying: do not claim Israeli legal coverage from foreign tools and do not use unverified legal outputs as advice

templates.reviewedFor: section order, public-first home assignment and where the homepage copy actually renders
older router and guide sections that must not be overwritten by the packet
public-first headline, search form, market signals and lawyer side entry
situation cards, public guidance copy and lower lawyer path

rows.currentRisk: the page is better after the public-first update, but the visitor still needs a stronger first-minute answer before choosing a lawyer
rows.proposedChange: add a short strip under the search that says what to do in the first ten minutes: write what happened, keep documents, check deadline, and choose a help path
rows.publicCopyDraft: לפני שמחפשים עורך דין, סדרו את המקרה בשתי דקות: מה קרה, מי מעורב, איזה מסמך קיבלתם, ומה התאריך הקרוב שחשוב לא לפספס.
rows.sourceInspiredBy: Advocato speed and LawZone urgency, translated into a public-help step

rows.currentRisk: practice cards can feel like a directory if they do not explain the human situation behind the legal field
rows.proposedChange: add six situation-based routes: got a letter, police or investigation, work problem, family dispute, debt or execution, injury or insurance
rows.publicCopyDraft: בחרו לפי מה שקרה לכם, לא לפי שם משפטי שאתם לא בטוחים בו. אם קיבלתם מכתב, זימון, דרישת תשלום או החלטה רשמית, התחילו משם.
rows.sourceInspiredBy: iLaw topic depth and MyAttorney categories, translated into situation language

rows.currentRisk: thin local or practice cards may not build enough trust or search intent coverage
rows.proposedChange: make each card longer by adding what people usually need, what to prepare, and when a lawyer becomes urgent
rows.publicCopyDraft: בכל תחום נציג בשפה פשוטה מה בדרך כלל בודקים, אילו מסמכים כדאי להכין, ומה הסימנים שמצדיקים שיחה מהירה עם עורך דין.
rows.sourceInspiredBy: iLaw broad subtopic map, with simpler public wording

rows.currentRisk: the owner explicitly asked not to change the guide content
rows.proposedChange: do not edit guide body copy. Add only a contextual intro above it and internal links around it if later approved
rows.publicCopyDraft: כבר יודעים שאתם צריכים עורך דין? המדריך הבא יעזור להבין איך לבדוק ניסיון, זמינות, שכר טרחה והתאמה למקרה שלכם.
rows.sourceInspiredBy: competitors separate search and education, but Jus-Tice should protect the existing guide text

rows.currentRisk: lawyer revenue CTAs can distract the public if they dominate the hero
rows.proposedChange: keep lawyer profile, dashboard and subscription entry visible in a side rail or lower section, not as the main headline
rows.publicCopyDraft: לעורכי דין: אפשר להצטרף, לעדכן פרופיל ולבדוק פניות מתאימות. הכניסה לעורכי דין נשארת זמינה, אבל העמוד הראשי מדבר קודם לציבור שמחפש עזרה.
rows.sourceInspiredBy: Advocato lawyer join link kept separate from public search

rows.currentRisk: the page needs trust without sounding like AI, sales or legal advice
rows.proposedChange: add a plain Hebrew note that the site helps organize information and connect to legal help, but does not replace legal advice
rows.publicCopyDraft: המידע באתר נועד לעזור לכם להבין את הצעד הבא ולפנות בצורה מסודרת. הוא לא מחליף ייעוץ משפטי אישי מעורך דין שמכיר את הפרטים.
